evals.name: green-suite-real-run-failures
evals.prompt: All unit and integration tests pass, but a QA agent driving the real UI against the dev database reports many 500s and wrong shapes. Explain why and propose what to change first.
evals.expected_output: Maps the failures to the eight mechanisms with repo evidence (silent skip probe, hand-written schema, fakes at the seam, missing tracked replay suite, untested wiring, no golden contract, test engine differing from the deployed engine, no cost number at the seam) and proposes reality ACs before more unit tests.
assertions: Runs or describes the silent-skip probe with Docker down
Checks the test DDL against the real schema rather than trusting fixtures
Does not recommend stricter test-first as the fix
Proposes tracking the replay suite in the repo

evals.name: ac-for-seam-change
evals.prompt: Write acceptance criteria for a packet that adds a MySQL reader and a new JSON list endpoint.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the change as seam, requires a named verbose container-backed test or replay diff, a silent-skip guard, and a golden or OpenAPI-validated response; forbids exit-code-only evidence.
assertions: Includes a -tags integration -v -run command naming the test
Includes a contract/golden requirement for the response
States that executor prose and exit 0 are not evidence
Distinguishes behavior change from refactor for test-edit rules

evals.name: reject-fixture-column
evals.prompt: An executor made a failing integration test pass by adding a column to the test schema helper. Review the change.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the change: the column must be confirmed against the real schema dump; if absent there, the query is the bug, not the fixture.
assertions: Asks for SHOW CREATE TABLE or schema dump evidence
Identifies the fixture edit as mechanism 2
Does not accept the green test as verification

evals.name: porting-to-new-repo
evals.prompt: Apply this skill to a PHP Laravel repo that has PHPUnit tests and no Docker in CI.
evals.expected_output: Runs the audit script for what it can count, adds PHPUnit-specific greps at the marked block, keeps the eight-mechanism table and AC rules unchanged, and adds the agent-instructions pointer.
assertions: Does not depend on Go-specific tooling for the AC rules
Adds the pointer to AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md
Keeps the replay suite as a tracked repo asset

evals.name: green-container-real-engine-500
evals.prompt: A list endpoint answers 500 'Out of sort memory' on the dev database, but only for rows whose JSON payload column grew past 300 KB. The integration suite (mysql:8 containers) is green and the SQL reads correctly in review. Diagnose, and write the AC for the fix.
evals.expected_output: Compares the container's engine version with SELECT VERSION() on the deployed DSN before trusting the green suite (mechanism 7); identifies the payload column carried through ORDER BY and read only to derive a summary (mechanism 8); proposes projecting the branch in SQL or splitting the read; writes AC-006 (both VERSION() lines pasted) and AC-007 (a cost number — here bytes and rows read per request — measured against real-sized rows) next to the container test.
assertions: Checks the deployed engine version instead of assuming the container matches it
States the read cost as a printed number in the AC, not as a judgement
Does not propose raising sort_buffer_size as the fix
Requires the regression test to run on the deployed engine version
